scholarships.title: UIC Admissions Scholarship (Underwood International College, Yonsei University)

existing.description: The UIC Admissions Scholarship is awarded by Underwood International College of Yonsei University to newly admitted international undergraduates and covers the full tuition for four years. UIC publishes an International Students Track tuition of 8,202,000 KRW per semester for the 2026 academic year, which is the amount the scholarship waives. There is no separate scholarship application: candidates are considered automatically during admission and offers are sent individually with the admission packet. Recipients must maintain a specified GPA each semester to keep the award in the following semester.
eligibility: Holds or expects to hold a high school diploma or certificate of high school equivalency before matriculating at UIC
Non-Korean with non-Korean parents under the International Students Track (Korean dual citizens are not eligible for that track)
Must maintain a certain level of GPA each semester to stay eligible for the following semester
existing.eligibility_summary: Newly admitted international students to Underwood International College. Applicants must be non-Korean with non-Korean parents to use the International Students Track, must hold or expect a high school diploma, and are considered for the scholarship automatically from their admission application.
benefits: Full tuition for 4 years (International Students Track: 8,202,000 KRW per semester)
No separate scholarship application needed - automatic consideration at admission
Scholarship offer letter enclosed in the admission packet
coverage: International Students Track tuition of 8,202,000 KRW per semester (2026 academic year)
requirements: each semester to stay eligible for the scholarship in the following semester.
documents: Printed copy of the online application form
Letter of Consent & Verification (from the UIC website)
Apostille/legalised official transcripts from all high schools attended
Apostille/legalised certificate of graduation or expected graduation
English proficiency test scores or accepted equivalents
Copies of the applicant and parents' passports or ID cards
Notarised birth certificate or proof of parent relationship
Receipt of the KRW 150,000 (or USD 150) application fee payment
existing.selection_notes: Applicants must submit an application form and required documents, which will be reviewed by the UIC office. If necessary, applicants will be called in for individual interviews with the scholarship committee.
existing.duration: Four years (8 semesters) of full tuition
existing.application_period: Two annual rounds. 1st Round (Spring 2027 entry): online application 10:00 on 26 Aug 2026 - 17:00 on 22 Sep 2026, document submission deadline 17:00 on 2 Oct 2026, interview 11-12 Dec 2026, notification 18 Dec 2026. 2nd Round (Fall 2027 entry): March 2027 (marked TBD).
existing.deadline_display: No separate scholarship application - UIC states applicants 'will be automatically considered as scholarship candidates'. The next admission round is the 2nd Round for Fall 2027 entry, with an online application deadline of 'March, 2027' that UIC labels 'TBD'.
existing.program_type: Undergraduate admission merit scholarship (automatic consideration at application)

existing.description: The Yonsei International Companion Scholarship is a Graduate School award for full-time international students who entered through the international student admission track and are enrolled in regular semesters. The Graduate School publishes fixed per-semester amounts of KRW 2,000,000 for master's students, KRW 3,000,000 for doctoral students and KRW 2,000,000 for students in the integrated master's and PhD programme. Support covers regular semesters only - four semesters for master's and PhD programmes and six for the integrated programme. Students who already hold a full Graduate School tuition scholarship, students of Medicine, Dentistry and Nursing, contract-based programme students and Mirae Campus students are excluded.
eligibility: Full-time international student at the Yonsei Graduate School
Enrolled in regular semesters through the international student admission track
Not receiving a full tuition scholarship from the Graduate School for regular semesters
Not enrolled in the College of Medicine, College of Dentistry or College of Nursing
Not a Graduate School student at Mirae Campus
existing.eligibility_summary: Full-time international students enrolled in regular semesters through the international student admission track at the Yonsei Graduate School. Excluded are students already receiving a full tuition scholarship from the Graduate School, students in the College of Medicine, College of Dentistry or College of Nursing, students in contract-based programmes, and Graduate School students at Mirae Campus.
benefits: Integrated master's and PhD: KRW 2,000,000 per regular semester
Automatic award - no separate application to submit
coverage: Integrated master's and PhD programme: KRW 2,000,000 per semester
requirements: For undergraduate program entrants, if a person who has graduated under Article 51(Requirements for Graduation) of the university regulations re-enrolls, the admission fee is reduced by half.
existing.duration: Regular semesters: 4 semesters for master's and PhD programmes, 6 semesters for the integrated master's and PhD programme
existing.application_period: Assessed for each regular semester of enrolment; no separate application period is published.
existing.deadline_display: No application deadline - the Graduate School's Foreigner Special Scholarship page states the award is for international-track students already enrolled in regular semesters, and eligibility is assessed per semester rather than by an application window.
existing.program_type: Graduate School internal scholarship for international students (no separate application)
